title: #193 Higher Salaries
prompt: Do you think students who go to university and pay full fees should earn higher salaries than those who do not go to university?

promptSegments.text: Do you think students who go to university and pay full fees should earn higher salaries than those who do not go to university?

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: University education provides specialized knowledge and skills, allowing graduates to take on more complex jobs and increasing their earning potential.

keyArguments: University education often leads to higher earning potential due to credentials and skills.
However, socioeconomic disparities can limit the true meritocratic value of education.
